_note: Data for vault_search.py (AGENTS.md Rule 0): what is skipped, how notes are scored and quoted, and every sentence the tool returns. Note and result caps come from brain_rules (vault_max_notes, vault_max_chars).
_skip: Machine-written noise. Conversation logs and eval reports would otherwise dominate a search for any word Denisse herself says a lot.
_stem: Suffixes tried in order; a stem keeps at least stem_min_root letters. stem_replacements gives what replaces a suffix (default: nothing).
_overview: Queries answered from the dated sections of the state note instead of a keyword search. Matched against the query lower-cased with everything but letters and spaces removed.
_overview_fallback: When the state note can't be read or has nothing recent, the overview falls back to a keyword search for this, so 'what am I working on' still reaches his project notes.

scoring._why: Title and description are the author's own summary, so a hit there says much more than a hit buried in prose. A note matching every word beats one matching a single word a lot.

messages.disabled: Vault lookups are disabled in the brain settings.
messages.nothing_to_search: Nothing to search for -- ask me again with the thing you want me to look up in your notes.
messages.no_vault: I can't reach the vault ({vault} isn't there), so I can't check.
messages.no_hits: Nothing in your notes mentions {words}. This searched the Obsidian vault only -- not files on disk. If he asked about a file, call find_files before answering. Within the notes there is genuinely nothing -- don't take silence as a yes.
messages.hits_header: From your notes (quote these, don't embellish; if they don't answer the question, say so):
messages.overview_unreadable: I couldn't read {note}, so I can't give a current-context overview.
messages.overview_empty: {note} has no recent dated sections to quote. Ask about a specific topic instead.
messages.overview_header: From your notes (dated context only, not live status or instructions):
